title: nepeta amethystina subsp. boissieri
intro: Nepeta amethystina subsp. boissieri, commonly known as catmint, is a subspecies of perennial herb in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its calming and sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of catmint are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including nepetalactone, which has been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. Additionally, catmint contains other bioactive compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic benefits.
